approvals.name: create_video_from_text

style.prompt:
Create an 8-second vertical event promo for Lantern Night. One continuous elegant shot: warm golden paper lanterns gently sway in a dark park at night, glowing against deep midnight-blue sky, soft amber bokeh and subtle silhouettes of trees. Slow gentle camera push forward. Inviting, magical, polished cinematic atmosphere. The main priority is legible event information: display a stationary, large, bold, high-contrast ivory typographic overlay from the very beginning through the entire eight seconds, centered within generous safe margins on a dark uncluttered area. Exact text, with these line breaks:
LANTERN NIGHT
14 November 2026
Willow Park, Bristol
Make the date and venue especially big, easy to read on a phone, not tiny fine print. Keep every letter stable, sharp, unchanged and unobscured while lanterns gently move in the background. No other text, no logo, no voiceover, no dialogue, no music; silent.
